source.source_text: Purpose: tightly scoped reboot/shutdown through privileged helper. Input: action:reboot|shutdown, reason?:string<=200, not_before?:timestamp. Output: accepted/rejected policy decision and scheduled/executed state; connection loss is expected after success. Contract: L5 privileged; scope mac.priv.power; target host; timeout 30000ms before handoff; cap 256KiB; no generic root command; explicit privileged policy/preconditions/kill-switch checks mandatory; non-idempotent with operation nonce/state guard. Phase 5 planned.
